resources.string: Your apps and settings are just where you left them.

string-array.name: whatsnew_new
string-array.item: Widgets come in up to three sizes: hold a widget and pick small, medium or large
The home clock is a widget: move it anywhere, in three sizes
Hold the brightness slider for Light / Dark theme and Eye protection
A new volume panel in the KiroOS design
Media volume in 30 steps, for finer control
New ringtone, alarm and notification sounds: Aurora, Sunrise, Glass, Drop and Spark
Speaker protection: no more crackling with loud sounds
New sounds for locking the screen and unlocking to the home
Game Space has its own place in Settings, under Battery
New, more vivid icons
More Vulkan extensions for apps and games

string-array.name: whatsnew_improvements
string-array.item: New app animation: the app grows out of its icon and flies back into it
Widgets, the drawer and folders move on the same soft spring
More precise haptics: one short, clean tap
More natural colors on the display
kAI starts a new chat when you open it (the last one is in History)
Canvas opens from the home: hold an empty spot, Wallpaper
KiroOS Equalizer is now Kiro EQ
KiroOS Update tells you when there is no internet and checks again on its own

string-array.name: whatsnew_optimizations
string-array.item: Smooth even when you open and close apps quickly
Web pages open faster in every app (KOptimize WebView compiled after updates)

string-array.name: whatsnew_fixes
string-array.item: The open / close animation no longer looks like a jump
The speaker no longer crackles with loud ringtones and bass-heavy music
Updated phones no longer keep the LineageOS sounds
Messages now pop up at the top while you use the phone
kAI\'s Stop button always stops the answer
The keys beside Home no longer vibrate on the always-on display
No more side light while kAI writes
